doc.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999

title: Moving to Las Vegas and landing the Buddy Rich job
summary: He played a season with the symphony, with his father also in it, then moved to Las Vegas, played show bands and got the Buddy Rich job.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: This was the San Diego Symphony?
And this was the one your father was in too?
He had sort of semi-retired. But we did get to play a little together in the orchestra.
Yeah, it was a wild story. And then later — I did that for a season and then I moved to Las Vegas. I had met some guys. Played a couple of show bands. And through there I got the Buddy Rich band job.
Were you playing electric at the same time?
Yes. At that point I was playing both.
